name: Steam
notes: Steam's interface (steamwebhelper, Chromium) composites in a separate process that draws into the browser's window, which Wine does not show: the window stays black. In-process and in software it shows, as with Proton. The first launch can stop on 'Failed to load steamui.dll' when a package of the update fails to download; launching again finishes the update. On a Retina display Wine gives programs 96 DPI, so Steam drew at half size; app_dpi gives Steam and its webhelper 192, as Windows at 200 %.
